output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the balance of the recipient address will overflow. It allows for a transfer of a large amount of tokens to a recipient who already has a large balance, causing an integer overflow.

The transferFrom function does not check if the balance of the recipient address will overflow. It allows for a transfer of a large amount of tokens to a recipient who already has a large balance, causing an integer overflow.
The approve function does not check if the balance of the spender address will overflow. It allows for a spender to approve a large amount of tokens to spend, causing an integer overflow.
The burn function does not check if the total supply will overflow. It allows for a burn of a large amount of tokens, causing an integer overflow.
The constructor of the MorphToken contract has a typo in the function name. It should be 'MorphToken' instead of 'MorphToken()'.
